tasks.subject: Task 1: Untrack rules.db, pin source, fix SA classification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `rules.db` becomes a generated, untracked artifact with a reproducible build, and the import classification stops depending on hand-authored effects.

**Files:**
- Modify: `Makefile` (new targets after `clean:` at line 116; RULES_EFFECTS stays the legacy `specs/data/rules.yaml` until Task 3 — controller ruling)
- Modify: `Hesindion/Services/OptolithImportService.swift:463-467`
- Create: `specs/rules/SOURCES.yaml`, `scripts/build_rules_db/verify_db.py`
- Modify: `HesindionTests/HeroImportTests.swift:62-64`, `AGENTS.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `git ls-files Hesindion/Resources/rules.db` prints nothing
- [ ] `make rules-db` rebuilds from the pinned source; `make rules-db-verify` exits 0
- [ ] `make rules-db` fails by name when the source is missing or checksums mismatch
- [ ] Boronmir import puts SA_884 and SA_661 in combatSpecialAbilities
- [ ] `hero.hasPlaenklerFormation == true` for that hero

**Verify:** `make rules-db && make rules-db-verify && make test-ui` → all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Makefile", "Hesindion/Services/OptolithImportService.swift", "Hesindion/Services/RulesDatabase.swift", "specs/rules/SOURCES.yaml", "scripts/build_rules_db/verify_db.py", "HesindionTests/HeroImportTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "make rules-db && make rules-db-verify && make test-ui", "acceptanceCriteria": ["rules.db untracked", "rules-db-verify exits 0", "build fails loudly on missing/mismatched source", "SA_884 and SA_661 classify as combat", "hasPlaenklerFormation true for Boronmir"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Authored-rule schema and linter
tasks.description:
**Goal:** An authored rule file has one machine-checkable shape, and that shape is the contract the engine plan consumes.

**Files:**
- Create: `specs/rules/schema.json`, `scripts/rules_lint/lint.py`, `scripts/rules_lint/requirements.txt`, `tests/rules/test_lint.py`
- Modify: `Makefile` (`rules-lint`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Valid file passes; unknown effect type, unknown predicate, missing `source.hash`, and a `text:` key each fail with a message naming file and key
- [ ] Filename must match `id`
- [ ] `make rules-lint` exits non-zero on any invalid file

**Verify:** `python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_lint.py -v` → 6 passed

```json:metadata
{"files": ["specs/rules/schema.json", "scripts/rules_lint/lint.py", "tests/rules/test_lint.py", "Makefile"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_lint.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["6 lint tests pass", "text key rejected citing Data Policy", "closed enums enforced for effect types and predicates"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Migrate 26 effect sets, delete duplicate sources
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One authored store. `specs/data/rules.yaml` and `HARDCODED_EFFECTS` are gone, and the database builds from `specs/rules/`.

**Files:**
- Create: `specs/rules/*.yaml` (26), `scripts/rules_lint/migrate_legacy.py` (one-shot, deleted in the same commit)
- Modify: `scripts/build_rules_db/build_db.py` (`--effects` takes a directory)
- Delete: `specs/data/rules.yaml`, `HARDCODED_EFFECTS` in `scripts/scrape_effects/scrape_effects.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 26 files under `specs/rules/`, all passing `make rules-lint`
- [ ] `effects` table has the same 79 rows as before the migration
- [ ] `grep -rn "HARDCODED_EFFECTS\|specs/data/rules.yaml" .` returns nothing

**Verify:** `make rules-db && sqlite3 Hesindion/Resources/rules.db "select count(*) from effects;"` → 79

```json:metadata
{"files": ["specs/rules/", "scripts/build_rules_db/build_db.py", "scripts/scrape_effects/scrape_effects.py"], "verifyCommand": "make rules-lint && make rules-db && sqlite3 Hesindion/Resources/rules.db 'select count(*) from effects;'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["26 authored files lint clean", "79 effect rows preserved", "no references to the deleted sources remain"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Golden corpus — ten rules authored by hand
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A reference encoding that the agent pipeline must reproduce before it is trusted with 232 rules.

**Files:**
- Modify: the 9 migrated files (SA_40, 41, 43, 48, 59, 65, 66, 67, 661) — real provenance and hashes
- Create: `specs/rules/SA_62.yaml`, `tests/rules/golden/`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Each of the ten has a real `source.url`, `book`, `page`, today's `checked`, and a hash matching live wiki text
- [ ] SA_62 encodes runUp ≥ 4 and gs ≥ 4, `dice: 2 + ceil(self.gs / 2)`, `opponentPassierschlagOnFailure`, `excludes: [SA_48]`, `subgroup: spezialmanoever`
- [ ] SA_43's BE effect carries `when: [{mounted: true}]`

**Verify:** `make rules-lint && python3 scripts/rules_sync/check.py --only specs/rules/SA_62.yaml` → `0 drifted`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["specs/rules/SA_62.yaml", "tests/rules/golden/"], "verifyCommand": "make rules-lint", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ten rules carry real provenance", "SA_62 encodes all four clauses of its rule text", "SA_43 carries the mounted condition"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: rules-sync-check — deterministic drift detection
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Answer "which encodings rest on text the wiki has since changed?" with no model involved.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/rules_sync/normalise.py`, `scripts/rules_sync/check.py`, `tests/rules/test_normalise.py`, `tests/rules/fixtures/*.html`
- Modify: `Makefile` (`rules-sync-check`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Two differently-formatted captures of the same rule text hash identically
- [ ] Each rule reports `ok`, `drifted` or `unverified`; exit 0 only when nothing drifted
- [ ] Requests cached on disk, rate-limited to one per second; a cached run makes no network calls

**Verify:** `python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_normalise.py -v && make rules-sync-check`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/rules_sync/normalise.py", "scripts/rules_sync/check.py", "tests/rules/test_normalise.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_normalise.py -v && make rules-sync-check", "acceptanceCriteria": ["normalisation stable across markup variants", "three-state drift report", "cached run makes no network calls"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Authoring subagents and their driver
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rule text in, reviewable encoding out — with a second agent that never sees the first one's answer.

**Files:**
- Create: `.claude/agents/rule-author.md`, `.claude/agents/rule-verifier.md`, `scripts/rules_sync/propose.py`, `tests/rules/test_propose.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `propose.py --ids SA_63,SA_56` writes both YAML files (lint-clean) plus `.proposals/<id>.review.md` with rationale, the verifier's independent encoding, and their diff
- [ ] Disagreements are stated at the top of the review file and left as a comment in the YAML — never silently resolved
- [ ] Batches of at most 12 rules per author agent, batches run in parallel
- [ ] Selectors `--ids`, `--group`, `--subgroup` (Task 9 drives waves by group); `.proposals/` git-ignored
- [ ] The script commits nothing

**Verify:** `python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_propose.py -v` (recorded agent outputs; no live calls)

```json:metadata
{"files": [".claude/agents/rule-author.md", ".claude/agents/rule-verifier.md", "scripts/rules_sync/propose.py", "tests/rules/test_propose.py"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_propose.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["two files written and lint-clean", "disagreement surfaced not resolved", "batch size 12 with parallel dispatch", "no commits from the script"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Calibration gate — reproduce the golden corpus
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the authoring setup is trustworthy before pointing it at 232 rules.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/rules/test_calibration.py`
- Modify: `.claude/agents/rule-author.md` (iterate the brief until it passes)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `propose.py` over the ten golden ids into a scratch directory reproduces the hand-authored effect rows for all ten — same types, values, conditions, tiers
- [ ] Author and verifier agree on all ten
- [ ] The run's summary table is captured in the close comment

**Verify:** `python3 scripts/rules_sync/propose.py --ids $(ls tests/rules/golden | sed 's/.yaml//' | paste -sd, -) --out /tmp/calibration && python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_calibration.py -v` → 10 passed, all `agree`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/rules/test_calibration.py", ".claude/agents/rule-author.md"], "verifyCommand": "python3 scripts/rules_sync/propose.py --ids $(ls tests/rules/golden | sed 's/.yaml//' | paste -sd, -) --out /tmp/calibration && python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_calibration.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ten of ten golden rules reproduced semantically", "author and verifier agree on all ten", "summary table captured in the close comment"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"], "gateScope": "task", "failurePolicy": "fix-the-brief-not-the-golden-files", "modelTier": "frontier"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Coverage ratchet
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Missing coverage becomes a number that can only go down, and absence can never be silent.

**Files:**
- Create: `tests/rules/test_coverage.py`, `specs/rules/COVERAGE.md`, `HesindionTests/RuleCoverageTests.swift`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Python test counts combat rules (group_id IN 3,9,10,11,12) without authored effects and fails above the recorded baseline
- [ ] Swift test asserts every rule on the UITestHero yields either structured effects or a reminder — never nothing
- [ ] `COVERAGE.md` lists, by subgroup, which rules are authored and which are reminder-only

**Verify:** `python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_coverage.py -v && make test-ui`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tests/rules/test_coverage.py", "specs/rules/COVERAGE.md", "HesindionTests/RuleCoverageTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -m pytest tests/rules/test_coverage.py -v && make test-ui", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ratchet fails when coverage regresses", "no-silent-absence test green on the seeded hero", "COVERAGE.md regenerated"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Authoring waves 1-3
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Complete coverage of what the engine can express, in reviewable increments.

**Files:** `specs/rules/*.yaml` (one PR per wave)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Wave 1: all 5 Basismanöver and 35 Spezialmanöver of group 3 (40 rules)
- [ ] Wave 2: the 49 passive abilities of group 3
- [ ] Wave 3: groups 9, 10, 11, 12 (143 rules)
- [ ] Every wave lints, sync-checks, ratchets coverage down, and is one PR
- [ ] No wave merges with an unresolved author/verifier disagreement

**Verify:** `make rules-lint && make rules-sync-check && python3 -m pytest tests/rules/ -v && make rules-db-verify`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["specs/rules/", "specs/rules/COVERAGE.md", "CHANGELOG.md"], "verifyCommand": "make rules-lint && make rules-sync-check && python3 -m pytest tests/rules/ -v && make rules-db-verify", "acceptanceCriteria": ["wave 1 covers all 40 maneuvers", "wave 2 covers 49 passives", "wave 3 covers the extended groups", "no unresolved disagreements merged"], "modelTier": "frontier"}
```
